title: Insolate
summary: IN'SOLATE, verb transitive [Latin insolo; in and sol, the sun.] To dry in the sun's rays; to expose to the heat of the sun; to ripen or prepare by exposure to the sun.

inlines.v: IN'SOLATE, verb transitive [Latin insolo; in and sol, the sun.] To dry in the sun's rays; to expose to the heat of the sun; to ripen or prepare by exposure to the sun.
